name: Update or escalate a case
intent: Notes, state transitions, and escalation through CSM playbooks / Flows.

mode.description: note = internal work note; comment = customer-visible comment; escalate = published CSM escalation path.

body.description: Text for the note, comment, or escalation justification.

procedure: Customer-visible comments confirm. Escalation uses the published path only.
sideEffects: Case journal and allowed case fields are written after confirmation; escalation invokes the published CSM playbook / Flow.

prompts: Add a customer-visible comment to CASE0010042: 'We are shipping the replacement today.'
Log an internal note on case CASE0010042 about the root cause we just found.
Escalate CASE0010042 — the customer is not responding and the service is down.
